title: Japan says combat drones key to adapting to new warfare as tension rises in the region
description: The government says Japan needs to adapt to the new methods of warfare like drones and artificial intelligence used in Ukraine and the Middle East and strengthen its defense industry. Japan has bolstered its military capability and spending in recent years and has started deploying long-range cruise missiles as a deterrence to China’s military activity. The defense paper adopted by the Cabinet on Tuesday reiterated that China is Japan’s biggest strategic challenge. Experts say developing fully homemade drones while Japan’s commercial drone market is dominated by Chinese imports would be a challenge. Japan has strengthened its military forces on southwestern islands as it worries about a conflict in Taiwan.
